jimmysparrow17: Yann Jimmysparrow stepped off the supply cart at S-F8 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
selfie_and_mugs_every_day2.0: At the depot, Wendel "Mole" Day had practised answering to his name. At S-F10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Wendel "Mole" Day, volunteer number 74, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
zaboravljeninemanjic: They issued Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lucky button in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
First Wave. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a lucky button.
A flare lit Blackwater Canal like noon. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni mended a split glove with pale thread. The repair makes one finger look as though it has been promoted.
The patrol returned one at a time. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni held the entrance clear and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.
